recognition: SA300 Self Assessment statement, or a Debt Management letter about unpaid Self Assessment tax (final reminder, demand, notice of enforcement).

facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: A statement of the Self Assessment account: tax due, payments made, payments on account, interest and penalties – or a letter chasing unpaid tax.
facts_for_explanation.payments_on_account: Most people pay twice a year in advance (31 January and 31 July), each half of last year's bill, plus a balancing payment on 31 January.
facts_for_explanation.interest: Interest runs on tax paid late, and late payment penalties of 5% can apply at 30 days, 6 months and 12 months.
facts_for_explanation.cant_pay: If the client can't pay in full, they can ask HMRC for a payment plan (Time to Pay). HMRC Self Assessment payment problems: 0300 200 3820.
facts_for_explanation.debt_letters: Debt Management letters should never be ignored: HMRC can take enforcement action. Contact HMRC before the date on the letter.
